description: For a limited company buying equipment, machinery or a van: how much of the cost comes off this year's profit (Annual Investment Allowance, full expensing, the 50% first-year allowance or writing down), the Corporation Tax that saves, and the same cost written down instead. Not for cars. Use for 'how much tax does a new van save my company?'.

aiaUsed.description: Annual Investment Allowance already used this year, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

cost.description: What it costs, before VAT if the company can claim the VAT back, in pounds.

isNew.description: True if new and unused, false if second hand. Defaults to true.

kind.description: main for most equipment, machinery and vans; special for built-in fixtures such as wiring and lifts, solar panels and long-life assets. Defaults to main.

profit.description: The company's taxable profit this year before this, in pounds.

name: calculate_capital_allowances
title: Capital allowances on equipment
